keyEvents.text: Tom Baack (Paderborn) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Daiki Hashioka (Borussia M'gladbach) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Marvin Pieringer (Paderborn).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Fabio Chiarodia (Borussia M'gladbach) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Paderborn. Steffen Tigges replaces Marvin Pieringer because of an injury.
Substitution, Paderborn. Felix Götze replaces Jano ter Horst.
Substitution, Paderborn. Laurin Ulrich replaces Tom Baack.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Isac Lidberg replaces Shuto Machino.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Nicolas Kühn replaces Robin Hack.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Ko Itakura replaces Florian Neuhaus.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Jens Castrop replaces Wael Mohya.
Tjark Scheller (Paderborn) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Paderborn. Rayan Philippe replaces Stefano Marino.
Laurin Ulrich (Paderborn) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
